coverage_model.covered: The intended club-admin workflow is available through the CLI. This does not imply one command per technical backend route.
coverage_model.core-partial: Useful core operations exist, but at least one important club-admin workflow is still missing.
coverage_model.intentional-exclusion: The top-level command is documented only as an explicit non-goal.

scope_note: Workflow-level registry for the 22 top-level commands wired in src/index.ts. Public, anonymous, internal, service-to-service and AI-provider routes are not required to have a CLI command. Gaps name missing CLI workflows, not every technical backend route.

intentional_exclusions: No password login and no token decoding; the opaque cvn_ token is verified server-side before it is stored.
Logout removes local CLI state; it does not revoke a device token on the server.
Transient user-service failures may use cached identity fields; authentication and authorization failures are never hidden.

gaps: The dispatcher has no general club profile update, department administration or settings read action.
intentional_exclusions: Homepage content is managed by homepage; members and teams have separate commands.

gaps: The dispatcher does not expose family, membership-status, role-history or bulk-import workflows.
intentional_exclusions: Team membership is managed through team member actions.

gaps: The dispatcher has no team create, show, update or delete action.

intentional_exclusions: Anonymous/public self-service routes, backend-internal routes and provider-specific technical administration are outside the club-admin CLI.

gaps: The dispatcher has no create, update, cancel or delete workflow for reservations.
The dispatcher has no object show, create, update, availability or delete workflow.
The dispatcher has no general update, reopen, cancel, delete, assignment-list or assignment-remove action.

intentional_exclusions: Ingredient, allergen and colorant administration is not exposed as recipe actions; template-backed recipe creation is the supported agent workflow.
Global templates are read-only; mutation and seeding are platform administration concerns.
generate and design deliberately fail: the operating agent composes content and CSS/design_config itself; the CLI never calls a backend LLM.

gaps: The current dispatcher is read-only and does not expose meeting/protocol lifecycle, agenda, participants, voting or resolution mutations.
intentional_exclusions: Public join/token flows, internal routes and AI-assistant internals are not club-admin CLI workflows.
generate and design deliberately fail; the agent composes a schema-valid homepage and uses club design for theme settings.

gaps: Machine-readable domain schemas are not yet available for every top-level command.
intentional_exclusions: coverage.json is a separate workflow-coverage registry and is readable offline.
Only visual or document surfaces with a deterministic verifier are included; verify is not a generic API health check.

gaps: Area-share/media-map workflows and publication/newsletter-specific administration are not exposed by the data dispatcher.
intentional_exclusions: Content analysis is performed by the operating agent after download; there is no analyze endpoint in this CLI.
The CLI does not call a writing LLM; the operating agent composes rich HTML. Anonymous public reads are a frontend concern.
Image generation itself is external to the CLI; illustrate prepares the deterministic kit and compose overlays exact labels.

gaps: The dispatcher has no generic tournament create/update/delete command; creation is available through a series execution.
intentional_exclusions: Public registration and public bracket reads are frontend/self-service concerns.

gaps: The dispatcher has no advertiser delete action and no update/delete action for an existing contract version.
intentional_exclusions: Global ad-marketplace and platform billing administration are outside local club sponsorship.
